name: Annihilation: Conquest
description: In the aftermath of the Annihilation Wave, the Phalanx seize control of Kree space using the weakened defenses as an entry point. A ragtag team of cosmic outcasts must break through the technorganic barrier before the entire galaxy is assimilated.
flavorText: Resistance is not futile. Resistance is all we have left.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Wonder / Awe Discovery. Cosmic assimilation and ragtag heroes breaking the technorganic Phalanx barrier. Ethereal strings and harp glissandi turning into crushing low brass. Vast cosmic scale, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
